section: Article I: Name | Section 1.1 Name:
text: The name of the entity shall be Minnesota RollerGirls, LLC, a limited liability company organized pursuant to Minnesota Statute 322B (hereafter referred to as "MNRD".

section: Article II: General | Section 2.1 General:
text:
MNRD is a member owned and operated league committed to playing roller derby. The purpose of this league is to: 
2.1.1 Promote the sport of flat track roller derby as per the League's stated Mission and Core Beliefs. 
2.1.2 Initiate and maintain rules and regulations for the governing of the league. 
2.1.3 Make efforts to financially fund the ongoing expenses of the league.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.1 Eligibility:
text: Membership Classifications including “Voting Members” and “Non-Voting Members” are defined in the MNRD Membership Policy.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.2 Voting Members Meetings:
text: Voting Members shall meet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.2 Voting Members Meetings - 3.2.1:
text: Notice of a meeting of the Voting Members shall be sent to the Voting Members by the Board, via the electronic league message board(s), no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special Meeting.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.2 Voting Members Meetings - 3.2.2:
text: Meetings of the Voting Members are not open to the public. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.2 Voting Members Meetings - 3.2.3:
text: Meeting notes will be distributed to all Voting Members via the electronic league messageboard(s) within two weeks.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.2 Voting Members Meetings - 3.2.4:
text: Special meetings of the Voting Members shall be held upon call of the Board or upon the written request of not less than twenty-five percent (25%) of the Voting Members. Such meetings shall be held at such time and at such place as shall be specified in the notice of the meeting.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.3 Voting Member Powers:
text: Each Voting Member may cast one vote in any election. Voting Members will vote on significant financial decisions of the league and any decision that impacts bylaws or significant policy changes. Policy clarifications do not require league votes.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.4 Voting Members Voting Process:
text: All formal league votes will be done electronically via league-managed systems. The vote announcement will state the purpose and duration of the voting period. The vote ballot will be open for a period of no less than (5) days.

section: Article III: Membership| Section 3.5 Voting Members Quorum:
text: No vote can be counted as valid until no less than a majority (more than 50%) of Voting Members have participated. Other MNRD policies may specify higher participation. If a majority of Voting Members have not responded by the stated duration end date, the vote will remain open until a majority has participated in the vote.

section: Article III: Membership | Section 3.6 Membership Approval and Dismissal:
text: New Member’s eligibility requirements, membership approval and membership dismissal guidelines are outlined in the MNRD Membership Policy.

section: Article III: Membership  | Section 3.7 Membership Attendance:
text: Details on how Voting Members may file for leave of absence, injured or inactive status are outlined in the MNRD Attendance Policy.

section: Article IV: Programs | Section 4.1 Program Structure:
text: MNRD shall endeavor to have Competitive, Recreational, and Officiating Programs.

section: Article IV: Programs | Section 4.1 Program Structure - 4.1.1 Competitive Program:
text: May Consist of Teams with a competitive play focus based on capacity, resources and interests.

section: Article IV: Programs | Section 4.1 Program Structure - 4.1.2 Recreational Program:
text: May Consist of Teams with a recreational or developmental play focus based on capacity, resources and interests.

section: Article IV: Programs | Section 4.1 Program Structure - 4.1.3 Officiating Program:
text: Consists of officials based on capacity, resources and interests.

section: Article IV: Programs| Section 4.2 Teams:
text: Teams are collections of Program Members with a shared goal and purpose. Teams shall be created and managed by Program Leadership.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 5.1.1 Eligibility:
text: Must have been a member of MNRD for at least one full derby season and preferably have leadership experience. If no candidate with the required full derby season membership runs, members who do not meet this requirement may be eligible. Board members are nominated by any league member, including themselves.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 5.1.2 Composition:
text: 5.1.2.1 A minimum of five and a maximum of eight individuals to proportionally represent Membership Classes. The representative to member ratio should be one representative to twenty members. A Board member may represent multiple Membership Classes in the event that a Membership Class does not elect a Board member.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 5.1.2 Composition:
text: 5.1.2.2 One non-voting outgoing Board member to assist with transition to the new Board, and to serve as a tiebreaker vote only as needed.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 5.1.2 Composition:
text: 5.1.2.3 The Board Chairperson is one member of the Board, voted in by majority vote of the Board. The Board Chairperson is responsible for executive decisions if the other members of the Board cannot be reached in special circumstances.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 5.1.3 Election:
text:
5.1.3.1 Membership Classes are responsible for voting in their respective Board member(s) on an annual basis (determined by the HR Department each season in April.) Members of any Membership Class may nominate a member of any Membership Class. 
5.1.3.2 Elections are facilitated by the HR Department.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.2 Executive Board of Directors Powers:
text: Each Board member is granted one vote per individual. The Board shall be the steering body of MNRD, and shall be responsible for managing the affairs of MNRD that are not specifically delegated to Voting Members, teams or Department Leads in these Bylaws or other governing documents or policies.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.2 Executive Board of Directors Powers:
text: 5.2.1 The Board will work with the Finance Department to approve the annual budget. Annual budgets are created based on a three-year rolling average. If it is determined that a greater than 10% deviation is needed from an annual budget, a Voting Member vote is necessary. Any new expenses over $5,000 require a vote of Voting Members.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.3 Executive Board of Directors Term:
text: All Board shall hold office until their respective successors are voted in by the respective membership class on an annual basis or until their earlier resignation or removal. Although the Board term is a one-year term, the Board will work toward turnover of 50% or less each year for continuity. Board members may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.4 Executive Board of Directors Meetings:
text: The Board shall meet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.4 Executive Board of Directors Meetings - 5.4.1:
text: Special meetings of the Board shall be held upon call of the Board Chairperson or upon the written request of a member of the Board. Such meetings shall be held at such time and at such place as shall be specified in the notice of meeting.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.4 Executive Board of Directors Meetings - 5.4.2:
text: Notice of a meeting of the Board shall be sent to each Board member in writing by the Board Chairperson no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special meeting.

section: Article V: Executive Board of Directors | Section 5.4 Executive Board of Directors Meetings - 5.4.3:
text: Meetings of the Board are not open to the public or other Members. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board. Meeting notes will be distributed to Members via the electronic message board(s) within two weeks.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1:
text: Representative Committees are committees made up of representatives of Membership Classes and the Representative Committee Chair. Representative Committees include Human Resources (HR), Anti-Racism and Anti-Exclusionary Committee (ARAE), and Safety.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1.1 Representative Committee - 6.1.1.1: Eligibility:
text: Representative Committee members are nominated by any league member, including themselves.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1.1 Representative Committee - 6.1.1.2: Composition:
text:
6.1.1.2.1 A minimum of five individuals to proportionally represent Membership Classes. A Representative Committee member may represent multiple Membership Classes in the event that a Membership Class does not elect a Representative Committee Member. 
6.1.1.2.2 Representative Committees may include other MNRD members at the discretion of the Committee.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1.1 Representative Committee - 6.1.1.3: Election:
text:
6.1.1.3.1 Membership Classes are responsible for voting in their respective Representative Committee members on an annual basis (determined by the HR Department each season in April.) Membership Classes may nominate a member of any Membership Class. 
6.1.3.2 Elections are facilitated by the HR Department.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1.2 Representative Committee Chair - 6.1.2.1: Eligibility:
text: The Representative Committee Chair is nominated by any league member, including themselves.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.1.2 Representative Committee Chair - 6.1.2.1: Election:
text: The Representative Committee Chair is elected by a majority vote of the Voting Members. Elections are facilitated by the HR Department.

section: Article VI: Representative Committees | Section 6.3 Representative Committee Term:
text: All Representative Committee members shall hold office until their respective successors are onboarded or until their earlier resignation or removal. Representative Committee members may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election:
text: Department Leads are Voting Members, and hold a title Director, Manager or Coordinator ("DMC").

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 7.1.1 Eligibility:
text: Department Leads are nominated by any league member, including themselves.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.1 Eligibility, Composition and Election - 7.1.2 Election:
text: Department Leads shall be appointed to their position after a one week review period. An election will be held if there are multiple candidates for an open Department Lead position. The HR Department will facilitate the election.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.2 Department Leads Powers:
text: The Department Leads operate and manage specific departments within MNRD, reporting to the Board for oversight.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.2 Department Leads Powers - 7.2.1 Decision Rights:
text: Significant department decisions, such as spending funds outside of annual budget allocations, must be presented to the Board for approval. Approval is granted with a majority vote of the Board. When appropriate, the Board will bring decisions to a Voting Member vote. Departments do not need to seek Board approval for day-to-day operational decisions.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.3 Department Lead Terms:
text: All Department Leads shall hold office until their respective successors are onboarded or until their earlier resignation or removal. Department Leads may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.4 Department Leads Meetings:
text: Department Leads shall meet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board. The Board may determine the timing for meetings according to the league practice and bout schedule.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.4 Department Leads Meetings - 7.4.1:
text: Notice of a meeting of the Department Leads shall be sent to each Department Lead in writing by the Board Chairperson, via Department Leads electronic message board(s), no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special meeting.

section: Article VII: Department Leads | Section 7.4 Department Leads Meetings - 7.4.2:
text: Meetings of the Department Leads are not open to the public or other Members. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board.
